videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: An exploration of the diverse wildlife that shares these rugged environments; we delve into the coexistence between humans and wildlife, revealing the mutual respect and careful balance required to thrive in these ecosystems.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: During the summer months, life is transformed under the perpetual daylight of the Arctic and northern regions; in Finland, Aki and Emilia experience the midnight sun; Morgan and Tone in Norway take advantage of extended daylight for hunting.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: The naturalists reflect on the importance of preserving cultural practices that date back generations; from falconry in Austria to fishing in Finland, examining how each person stays connected to ancient techniques.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: As autumn turns to winter, the naturalists prepare for the harsh conditions ahead; the preparations each naturalist undertakes to endure the intense cold, whether by stocking food, reinforcing shelters.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: The naturalists share how climate change impacts their environments and the traditions they cherish; with shifting weather patterns and the decline of certain wildlife populations, each individual faces new challenges in their respective regions.

videos.title: Love of the Wild
videos.description: A reflection on the connection each naturalist shares with the wild places they call home; stories of resilience, survival and dedication to nature; as they look forward, each naturalist reflects on the profound.
